title: Derived Enhancements of $T$-fixed subschemes
summary: For $X$ a conical affine symplectic singularity with $\mathbb{T}=T \times \mathbb{G}_m$-action, the fixed scheme $X^T$ and the map $X^T \rightarrow X$ carry much information about the geometry of $X$. In general, $X^T \rightarrow X$ fails to be a complete intersection. Thus, we study a derived intersection whose classical locus is the $T$-fixed subscheme $X^T$. We show that the structure of the symplectic singularity on $X$ produces a duality theorem for the structure sheaf of the derived intersection.
